name: Rasial
blurb: Necromancy for Rasial, the First Necromancer. Phase-aware, with conjure upkeep and a bail-out.

name: Raksha
blurb: Solo Raksha, the Shadow Colossus. Tracks the shadow phases and clears the anima pools before they stack.

name: Arch-Glacor (HM)
blurb: Hard-mode Arch-Glacor with configurable settings. Good money maker.

name: Kerapac Solo & Duo (HM)
blurb: Solo/Duo Kerapac, Wielder of Time. Handles the pillar phase and the stun window without babysitting.

name: Gates of Elidinis
blurb: Easiest skilling boss ever. Mine, jump and loot!

name: Vorkath (HM)
blurb: Hard mode Vorkath! Claim those scales and loot the dragon bones. No babysitting required.
